battle.name: 武街之戰
battle.brief: 開元二年（714）八月，吐蕃大將坌達延、乞力徐率十餘萬臨洮州，轉攻蘭州、湟源縣，與唐邊軍在河湟交鋒至十月。吐蕃所圖在牧場與馬群，唐軍則據城固守、以弓弩拒敵。卡面的亞述長弓出於公元前七百年的兩河流域，比本役早逾千年，其弓兵開路、車兵跟進之組合，在河湟對應唐軍步弓手與吐蕃角弓長槊。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 武街之戰是唐與吐蕃在河湟一線的一場邊境戰役，交戰的主體是唐朝隴右、河西的邊軍與吐蕃自青海方向南下的大軍。唐一方的兵員來自關內及隴右諸州的郡兵、募兵，以及屯田與監牧之軍，戰前分散在蘭州、湟州、洮州一線的城鎮與軍寨；當時隴右尚未常設節度使，河西節度使始置於開元十二年，隴右節度使則在開元二十一年，因此臨戰的調度多由沿邊都督、刺史與中書、兵部臨時處分，主帥之權與調兵之速都受制於距離。吐蕃一方以本部軍隊為主，由贊普以大論與族姓將領統率，兵員包含自青海與藏北牧區徵發的步卒、弓手與騎兵，另有隨征的屬國部眾與負擔輜重的人夫，其作戰目標除城池外，也包括牧場、牲畜與俘獲的裝備。兩軍同隸各自國家的常設軍令系統，武器配備、騎兵比例與後勤方式卻差異極大：唐以步卒、弩手與城防為骨架，吐蕃以騎兵、弓手與高原機動為骨架，這一結構差異正是本役攻防節奏的底色。
countriesEn: The Battle of Wujie was a frontier campaign fought between the Tang dynasty and the Tibetan Empire along the Huang and Tao river corridors in what is now western Gansu and eastern Qinghai. On the Tang side the field forces were drawn from the militia and recruited troops of the prefectures, the garrisons of the border forts, and the soldiers of the state farms and of the official pastures spread across Lanzhou, Huangzhou and Taozhou. The circuit commanderies of the northwest did not yet exist in permanent form: the Hexi jiedushi was only created in the twelfth year of Kaiyuan and the Longyou jiedushi in the twenty-first, so command and mobilization were handled on the spot by the frontier governors and prefects, while the capital sent out emergency orders along the postal roads. On the Tibetan side the army was the core army of the Tibetan state, commanded by the btsan po through great ministers and through generals of the great clan families, with infantry, bowmen and horsemen drawn from the pastures of Qinghai and northern Tibet, supported by dependent tribal contingents and by train followers whose work was to move the booty. Alongside the towns, the Tibetan war aim in this campaign also included pastures, livestock and captured equipment. Both armies belonged to the standing command systems of their own states, yet their weapons, their proportion of cavalry and their methods of supply differed sharply: the Tang were built on infantry, crossbowmen and fortification, the Tibetans on cavalry, massed archery and movement across high plateau. That structural contrast is the background against which the rhythm of attack and defence in this campaign unfolded.
people: 吐蕃方面，率十餘萬眾自青海南下的是大將坌達延與乞力徐，據史載兩人是本役的統兵人物；吐蕃贊普尺帶珠丹在位，其治下大論一族與族姓將領掌握兵權，開元初年吐蕃在河湟的每一次出兵都出自其授意。乞力徐所屬的論氏在往後十餘年間仍是吐蕃東線的主要將姓，坌氏亦為青海一帶的軍事家族，其子弟多在邊地領兵。唐一方留下的記載要零碎得多：《舊唐書》《新唐書·吐蕃傳》只記洮州一役有都督陣亡、將士死守，以及玄宗詔令邊軍嚴加守禦，具體姓名與戰後去向多不詳，本役唐方主將的姓名在傳世文獻中已難確指。開元初年執政的姚崇、宋璟一輩整飭邊軍、裁汰冗兵，對隴右兵力的補救多在事後，這一處的失着也常被後人歸咎於本役的失手。可以確定的是，開元二年唐廷在兵馬、糧秣的調度上仍仰賴長安至隴右的驛道與各州軍資，這條調度鏈條的效率，直接決定了蘭州與湟源縣能守多久。史載有限之處正在於：此役唐方未留下如後來青海之役那樣完整的主將名錄與戰績記載。
peopleEn: On the Tibetan side the men who brought more than a hundred thousand fighters down from Qinghai were the generals Dadan of the Ba clan and Qilixu; the transmitted histories name these two as the commanders of the campaign. The Tibetan btsan po Chidai Zhudan, known in Tibetan sources as Trisong Detsen, was on the throne, and under him the great ministers of the lon and the generals of the great families held the military power; every Tibetan operation in the Huang and Tao region in the early Kaiyuan years was ordered from him. The Rin clan to which Qilixu belonged remained the leading surname of the eastern front for more than a decade afterwards, and the Ba clan was a military family of the Qinghai region whose members repeatedly led troops on that border. The Tang side is far more thinly documented: the Jiu Tangshu and the Xinyangshu account of the Tibetans record only that a dudu fell at Taozhou, that the soldiers held their ground, and that the emperor ordered the frontier garrisons to defend their posts strictly. Names and later careers of the Tang commanders are largely lost, and the commander in chief of this campaign can no longer be identified with certainty. The statesmen Yao Chong and Song Jing, who governed at the beginning of the Kaiyuan era, reorganized the frontier armies and cut excess troops, and the replenishment of Longyou came largely after the event; this failure of preparation is often blamed in later accounts for the setback. What can be established is that in the second year of Kaiyuan the Tang still moved troops and grain by the postal road from the capital to Longyou and by the military stores of the prefectures, and the efficiency of that chain of command decided how long Lanzhou and Huangyuan could hold out. The limits of the record lie in the fact that this campaign left behind no such complete list of Tang commanders and results as the later battle in Qinghai did.
kits: 本卡兵器是亞述長弓，年代定於公元前七百年前後，屬亞述帝國的短型複合角弓：角、筋、木三材合製，弓臂短而張力大，配鐵鏃之箭與短劍；弓兵常在車上發射，車兵則倚弓兵開路，亞述正是靠弓與鐵的組合，才有前九至前八世紀對兩河流域的征服。必須說明的是，這件武器在開元二年早已不存於世，卡面取的是弓這一兵種的源流象徵，並非本役的實配裝備。落到河湟的實戰，雙方的弓同屬這一技術譜系：唐軍以步弓配箭鏃，另有臂弩與蹶張弩提供中遠程壓制，騎兵用較長的騎弓，並配唐刀、方天畫戟與長柄馬槊；吐蕃步卒用角筋合製的複合弓，長槊與大盾並用，騎兵除角弓外另備可拋射的標槊與短刀，鎧甲以鎖子甲和皮甲為主。馬匹同樣是本役的裝備核心：吐蕃靠高原牧場的馬群維持騎兵，於是監牧馬場成為爭奪的目標，唐方的挽馬與騎馬多來自隴右、關中牧監，遭奪之後短期內難以補充。攻城器械方面，本役記載只見強攻城垣與掠奪牲畜，未載唐人使用大型攻城器械，也未見雲梯、撞車一類的正式記載；吐蕃的攻城則以步卒結陣近垣、弓箭壓制城頭的粗樸方式進行。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Assyrian bow, dated to around the seventh century before the common era, a short composite bow of the Assyrian empire: horn, sinew and wood combined, with a short but powerful limb, used with iron-tipped arrows and a short sword. The archers shot from the wagons and the wagon crews advanced behind the archers, and Assyria's conquest of the river plains of the two rivers in the ninth to eighth centuries before the common era rested on that combination of bow and iron. It has to be said that this weapon had long ceased to exist by the second year of Kaiyuan; the card uses it as the archetype of the weapon family, not as the equipment actually carried in this campaign. In the fighting at Huang and Tao, the bows of both sides belonged to the same technological lineage. The Tang used infantry bows with arrow heads, supported by arm bows and strong drawn crossbows for medium and long range pressure, while their horsemen used the longer riding bow, together with the Tang sabre, the fangtian trident and the long lance. Tibetan infantry used composite bows of horn and sinew, combining the long spear with the large shield, and their cavalry carried curved bows, throwing javelins and short knives, with chain mail and leather armour. Horses were as central to the equipment as the bows: the Tibetans kept their cavalry supplied from the plateau pastures, which is precisely why the official pastures became the object of the contest, while the Tang drew their draft and riding horses from the pastures of Longyou and the Guanzhong region and could not easily replace animals that had been taken. As for siege equipment, the record of this campaign mentions only assaults against city walls and the seizure of livestock; it does not record the Tang using heavy siege machines, nor any formal mention of ladders or battering rams, and the Tibetan assault relied on the plain method of infantry closing to the wall under a shower of arrows.
tactics: 本役的戰術框架由地理與季節決定。吐蕃自青海方向沿洮河谷地南下，八月二十日以大隊逼近洮州（治美相縣，今甘肅省臨洮縣），迫使唐軍收縮城防；其後分兵轉向蘭州與湟州湟源縣，目標是監牧的馬群與草場，這樣的選擇避開了唐軍在城下的消耗戰，也利用了八至十月牧草豐美、馬匹正壯的時節。唐軍的應對以城為本：步兵倚城垣與城壕，弓弩手居高覆蓋城下的接近線，長槊手封閉缺口，盡量不與吐蕃騎兵在城外展開野戰；少量騎兵出城騷擾，企圖切斷吐蕃的退路與牧群牧隊。吐蕃的攻城與野戰配合，與其高原傳統一致：長槊兵與持盾步卒結陣逼近，弓手在後列密集齊射覆蓋，騎兵在兩翼牽制唐軍出城之師，同時牧人與馬隊在後方轉移畜產。補給上，吐蕃以青海通道作為後方生命線，遠征兵員靠青稞、糌粑與馬肉自持，行動窗口受冬季封山限制；唐方則靠關中轉運的糧秣、各州屯田所出與城內儲備維繫，一旦外線州縣失守，援軍需時數十日才能趕到。十月，吐蕃目的既已部分達成，遂收兵退回青海方向。
tacticsEn: The tactical frame of this campaign was set by geography and by the season. The Tibetans came down from Qinghai along the valley of the Tao river. On the twentieth day of the eighth month they brought their main body up to Taozhou, whose seat was at Meixiang county in what is now Lin Tao in Gansu, and forced the Tang to contract behind its walls. They then split off towards Lanzhou and towards Huangyuan in Huangzhou, aiming at the official pastures, their horses and their grass: a choice that avoided the war of attrition the Tang could fight from behind walls, and that also took advantage of the months when the pasture grass was thick and the horses were in prime condition. The Tang answered on the defensive, with the town as the anchor: infantry leaning on the walls and the ditch, archers and crossbowmen on the heights covering the approach lines below, spearmen sealing the gaps, and every effort made to avoid a general engagement outside the walls against the Tibetan cavalry, while a small number of horsemen rode out to harass and to try to cut the Tibetan retreat and the herds. The Tibetan assault combined with the field action according to the plateau tradition: spearmen and shield infantry closing in in formation, archers massed behind them firing in volleys, cavalry working both flanks to pin down Tang troops that tried to leave the towns, while drovers and horse trains moved the livestock away to the rear. In supply, the Tibetans used the Qinghai corridor as their line of life, and the troops on campaign lived on barley, tsampa and horse meat, so their window of operation was bounded by the passes closing in winter. The Tang depended instead on grain carried from Guanzhong, on the produce of the state farms in the prefectures and on the stores inside the towns, and once an outlying prefecture fell the reinforcements needed tens of days to arrive. In the tenth month, with part of the aim achieved, the Tibetans withdrew towards Qinghai.
data: 可用的數字有限，而且多為概括語。兵力方面，史籍明載吐蕃大將坌達延、乞力徐等率眾十餘萬臨洮州，這是本役唯一明確的兵力記載；唐軍的出動人數，各書只作「唐兵赴之」一類的簡筆記載，具體數目已無可考，僅可知唐方以分散在隴右各州的郡兵與邊軍應敵。時間方面，戰役自開元二年八月二十日吐蕃大軍臨洮州起，至十月止，前後約三個月。距離上，洮州至吐蕃腹地拉薩直線逾一千五百公里，蘭州至湟源縣約一百五十公里，前線與吐蕃後方之間靠數百里牧道相連，屬典型的高原外緣遠征。損失方面，本役最確切的後果是吐蕃奪走唐在湟州一帶監牧的大批馬匹，數量以萬計而各書未載確數；唐軍的陣亡人數亦無明文可考。參戰的城鎮至少有三處：洮州美相縣、蘭州五源縣與湟州湟源縣。兵力對比上，十餘萬對唐邊軍的有限出動，是本役最懸殊的一組數字，也正是唐軍選擇據城防守、避免野戰的直接理由。
dataEn: The usable figures are few, and most of them are general statements. On troops, the histories state plainly that the Tibetan generals Dadan and Qilixu brought more than a hundred thousand men to Taozhou; this is the only firm troop figure attached to the campaign, and the number of Tang troops sent out is recorded only in cursory phrases of the kind that the Tang soldiers marched to meet them, the exact figure being lost. On time, the campaign ran from the twentieth day of the eighth month of the second year of Kaiyuan, when the main Tibetan force appeared before Taozhou, to the tenth month, a matter of some three months. On distance, Taozhou lies more than fifteen hundred kilometres in a straight line from Lhasa in the Tibetan interior, while Lanzhou is about a hundred and fifty kilometres from Huangyuan; the front line and the Tibetan rear were joined by several hundred kilometres of track across pasture, so this was a typical expedition launched from the edge of the plateau. On losses, the most certain consequence of the campaign was that the Tibetans took away a large number of the horses the Tang kept in the official pastures around Huangzhou, the count running into many thousands but never stated exactly in the sources; the Tang dead are not recorded numerically either. At least three towns were involved: Meixiang in Taozhou, Wuyuan in Lanzhou and Huangyuan in Huangzhou. On the balance of force, more than a hundred thousand on the Tibetan side against the limited Tang deployment is the most lopsided set of numbers in the campaign, and it is the direct reason why the Tang chose to defend from towns and to avoid a general engagement in the open.
cause: 起戰有遠近兩層原因。遠因是河湟與青海一帶的結構性衝突：吐蕃在高原的擴張需要穩定的牧場、鹽源與穀物通道，唐則把隴右視為屏障京師與關中的前沿，兩國在湟水、洮河、大通河流域的堡寨與牧監互相逼近，每一處小小的界址改動都可能演成兵端。開元初年唐廷剛經歷宮廷變動與新君即位，朝廷正忙於整飭軍政、裁汰冗兵，隴右一線的野戰調度一時吃緊；同期吐蕃內部大論勢力上升，贊普對青海與河湟方向用兵少了節制。近因則是邊地糾紛與使節往來的破裂：開元初年吐蕃曾遣使交涉，涉地界、通道與俘虜歸還之事，唐廷未盡如吐蕃之意，雙方互商不成，各自加強了邊防部署，終至在大軍壓境時全面爆發。也有記載把此役視為吐蕃蓄意削弱唐的監牧、以截斷唐騎兵來源的算計；此說於戰局合理，但史無明文可以坐實，姑備一說。此外，開元二年秋的牧草與馬匹正好進入最狀，這一向是高原部眾用兵的時節，兵出與時令相合，也可視為客觀上的推力。
causeEn: The war had both a proximate and a distant set of causes. The distant cause was the structural friction along the Huang and Qinghai corridor: the Tibetan expansion on the plateau required stable pastures, salt sources and grain routes, while the Tang treated Longyou as the shield before the capital and the Guanzhong plain, and the two states' forts and official pastures in the valleys of the Huang, Tao and Datong rivers pressed close against each other, so that any small change in a boundary could turn into a military incident. In the early Kaiyuan years the Tang court had just gone through a change of government and the accession of a new emperor, and was busy restoring military administration and cutting surplus troops, which left the field strength on the Longyou front thin for a time. At the same moment power within the Tibetan state was passing to the great ministers, and the btsan po was not restrained in his use of the Qinghai and Huang river directions. The proximate cause was the breakdown of border disputes and of negotiations: in the early Kaiyuan years the Tibetans sent envoys to discuss boundaries, the opening of routes and the return of prisoners, and the Tang court did not grant all that the Tibetans asked, so the exchange broke down and both sides reinforced their border deployments until the whole matter came to a head when a great army appeared on the frontier. Some accounts also read the campaign as a deliberate Tibetan move to weaken the Tang pastures and cut off the source of Tang cavalry; the reading fits the course of the fighting, but the histories do not confirm it in so many words, and it is offered here only as a possibility. In addition, the grass and the horses of the eighth and tenth months of the second year of Kaiyuan were at their best, which was the traditional season for highland armies to take the field, and the timing of the expedition matched the season.
impact: 本役的直接結果，是唐在湟州一帶的監牧馬群大批落入吐蕃之手，隴右騎兵的補充立刻變得緊張，唐廷此後對牧場與馬政的管控明顯收緊，隴右的監牧、括馬與邊軍屯田都因此被提到更重要的位置。這種制度性的回應在開元年間逐步成形：開元十二年始置河西節度使以專責邊防，開元二十一年再置隴右節度使，邊防的重心由臨時調兵轉為常設軍鎮。作戰層面，吐蕃在青海方向的打法逼唐廷重視弓弩、壕壘與城防，也讓河西、隴右的將領在十餘年後的青海戰場上有了直接的經驗：開元十二年（724）吐蕃陷承式堡，河西節度使哥舒翰引兵救之，追擊至青海洪濟城，大破吐蕃，俘獲數千、牛羊以萬計、器械數百套，這一役把開元二年積累的教訓換成了戰果。戰略之外，開元年間唐蕃之間仍有修好與往來，開元十八年（730）以金城公主和親吐蕃，把衝突暫時壓到外交層面處理。可以說，武街之戰既是唐蕃在河湟握手前的又一個開端，也是雙方把邊境爭鬥制度化、長期化的一個節點。
impactEn: The direct outcome of the campaign was that a large part of the horse population of the Tang pastures around Huangzhou passed into Tibetan hands, and the replenishment of Longyou cavalry became tight at once. The court tightened its control of pastures and horse administration accordingly, and the official pastures, the roundups of horses and the frontier farms of Longyou all moved up in importance. That institutional response took shape over the Kaiyuan years: the Hexi jiedushi was created in the twelfth year of Kaiyuan to take charge of the frontier, and the Longyou jiedushi followed in the twenty-first, so that frontier defence shifted from ad hoc dispatch to standing garrison towns. At the level of fighting, the Tibetan way of war in the Qinghai direction forced the Tang to attend to bows, crossbows, ditches and walls, and it gave the generals of Hexi and Longyou direct experience that would be used on the Qinghai front more than a decade later: in the twelfth year of Kaiyuan, 724, the Tibetans seized Chengshi fortress, and the Hexi commander Geshu Han marched to the rescue and pursued them to the Hongji city in Qinghai, destroying the Tibetan force, taking several thousand prisoners and large numbers of cattle, sheep and several hundred sets of equipment. That victory turned the lessons accumulated since 714 into results. Beyond strategy, there were still embassies and a settlement between the two states in the Kaiyuan years, and in the eighteenth year, 730, a Tang princess was married to the Tibetan ruler, which pushed the conflict back down to the diplomatic level for a time. The Battle of Wujie was thus both another beginning of the long contest between the Tang and the Tibetans over the Huang and Tao corridor, and a node in which that contest was given institutional and lasting form.
result: 戰果上，吐蕃得手：他們在八月二十日逼臨洮州，隨後轉攻蘭州與湟源縣，唐朝在湟州一線的監牧馬群被大量奪走，邊地的牧場控制權與物資收益盡入吐蕃之手；唐廷則守住了蘭州與洮州等核心城鎮，各書未記此役中蘭州失陷，洮州亦未被長久佔領，因此本役並沒有改變河湟的基本格局。戰局上，吐蕃在十月收兵退回青海方向，達到奪馬與消耗唐軍的目的即止；唐軍損失有限，卻暴露了隴右在開元初年兵員分散、節制未定的弱點，逼迫朝廷其後在河西、隴右設節度使、整軍備、增屯田。對雙方關係而言，武街之戰屬於唐蕃長期角力中的一次局部得手，而不是決定性的一役；它在雙方的記憶裏留下的是同一課：唐需要更牢固的城防與更充裕的馬匹，吐蕃需要更完整的青海至河湟的控制，兩者都在往後十數年裡繼續朝這個方向用力。史載有限，但可以確定的是：開元二年秋，戰火確實燒到了洮河與湟水兩岸，而唐朝對這條邊線的重新佈防，正是在這場戰役之後才真正開始。
resultEn: In terms of results the Tibetans had the better of it. On the twentieth day of the eighth month they closed on Taozhou, then turned against Lanzhou and Huangyuan, and the Tang horses of the pastures along Huangzhou were carried off in bulk, so that control of the pastures and the produce of the borderland went to the Tibetans. The Tang on the other hand held their principal towns, Lanzhou and Taozhou: no book records the loss of Lanzhou in this campaign, and Taozhou was not held for long, so the basic shape of the Huang and Tao region did not change. The campaign itself ended in the tenth month, when the Tibetans withdrew towards Qinghai, having taken the horses and worn down the Tang troops, which was as much as they had come for. Tang losses were limited, but the campaign exposed the weakness of Longyou in the early Kaiyuan years, where the troops were scattered and the chain of command unsettled, and it pressed the court afterwards to create circuit commanderies in Hexi and Longyou, to put the army in order and to expand the frontier farms. For the relations between the two states this was a local success within a long contest rather than a decisive battle. The lesson it left was the same on both sides: the Tang needed stronger walls and more horses, the Tibetans needed unbroken control from Qinghai down to the Huang and Tao valleys, and both kept pushing in that direction for the next decade and more. The record is thin, but what can be settled is this: in the autumn of the second year of Kaiyuan the war did reach both banks of the Tao and the Huang, and the real redeployment of the Tang along that frontier began only after this campaign.
